description.name: MainWP for WHMCS
description.tagline: Sell care for WordPress sites under your own name and keep each site on MainWP in step with billing.
description.long: Puts each paid care add-on's WordPress site on your own MainWP dashboard through MainWP's REST API. Clients connect their site from the client area; non-payment suspends care on the dashboard, payment resumes it and ending care removes the site. A daily check reports what is out of step. Works with the free MainWP Dashboard plugin. This add-on module holds the settings, the staff pages, the client's connect page and the daily check; it works with the MainWP for WHMCS provisioning module.
features: Clients connect their own WordPress site from the client area
Suspends, resumes and removes sites on the dashboard as WHMCS bills
A daily check and an email digest of what needs attention
Clients read your care add-on's name; nothing the module shows them names MainWP
Dry-run mode to see what would happen before going live
